signal: Terret launched its Virtual Revenue Fleet and Terret Nexus, an AI revenue platform built for CROs and VPs of Sales, with customers like Carta, Cloudflare and Mistral on $43M raised.

email.body1:
Benjamin, saw Terret roll out the Virtual Revenue Fleet and Nexus, with names like Cloudflare and Mistral already on board.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals quietly stall, ironic for a revenue platform. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Terret off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Benjamin, quick follow-up for Terret.

With new logos landing, pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount can. Most leaders cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Terret needs to cover this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Benjamin, last bit of proof for Terret.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Terret's reply rate likely compares to other AI revenue startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Benjamin, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything when you are landing marquee logos, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an AI revenue motion? I will tailor it to Terret either way.
